properties.name: The v0.24.0 version bump. DESIGN_HOLDS deliberately: the design meaning of a cut lives in the Release node and its epoch, never in a version string, so nothing about what this project IS moved here. This drift is structural to every cut — reflow2.toml is a registered artifact and bumping it is step 1 — and accepting it BEFORE freezing the release manifest is what stops the manifest recording the pre-bump checksum and costing a second export.
